Mølle er et gammelt brettspill for to. F: Nine men's morris is an old board game for two. Get three pieces in a row – a mill – and take one of your opponent's pieces.
Dere har ni brikker hver og setter dem u: You have nine pieces each and take turns placing them on the dots, one at a time. White starts.
Når alle brikkene står på brettet, flytt: When every piece is on the board, you move one piece along a line to a free dot next to it. Three in a row along a line is a mill: then you take one of your opponent's pieces.
Den som bare har to brikker igjen, eller: Whoever is down to two pieces, or can't move, has lost. With three pieces left you may jump to any free dot.
Brikker i en mølle kan ikke tas – med mi: Pieces in a mill can't be taken – unless all of your opponent's pieces are in mills.
Flytt en brikke ut av en mølle og tilbak: Move a piece out of a mill and back again, and you have a new mill.
